name: Michael Dell

onTheRecord.finding: 990-PF FY2024 officer/key-employee compensation: Janet Mountain (Exec Director/Sec/Asst Treasurer) $568,840 + $74,758 other; Anand Srinivasan (COO) $492,144 + $67,782; Robert Lindsey (General Counsel) $352,245 + $68,869; Geeta Goel (Managing Director, India) $333,189; Marita Kurian (VP Tech) $323,515; Aliya Hussaini (Portfolio Director) $301,922. Michael S. Dell (President/Director), Susan L. Dell, Dr Alexander Dell, Marc Lisker: $0.

Contributions received jumped to $3,573,647,703 in FY2023 and $1,450,477,987 in FY2024 (vs $44.1M in FY2022), taking book-value total assets from $1.64B (2022) to $5.42B (2023) to $7.77B (2024); charitable disbursements were $184.4M (2022), $171.8M (2023), $218.9M (2024).

FY2021 and FY2022 990-PFs include a 'Distribution from Corpus Election' schedule and FY2020 an 'Applied to Prior Year Election' schedule; FY2019-2024 filings include Expenditure Responsibility Statements and (2019, 2023, 2024) Transfers To Controlled Entities schedules.

notes: Foundation figures are IRS end-of-year book values from ProPublica's 990-PF extract (total assets $7,770,844,151, liabilities $241,607,240, net assets $7,529,236,911 for FY2024). Foundation also files 990-T annually. Forbes real-time net worth $273.7B as of 9/26/26 (page last updated Sep 15, 2026); Philanthropy Score 2.
